summary: Iteration 5 (pre-App-Store final verification). Backend: 47/47 pytest passing (33 previous + 14 new in test_deletion_legal_support.py) covering account deletion, referral integrity on deletion, public legal pages, /api/legal/info, /api/support (auth+validation+persistence), and Apple auth 401 with optional authorization_code. Delete flow verified end-to-end: DELETE /api/auth/me returns {ok:true, apple_revoked:false, files_deleted>=1, deleted:{bills>=1, notifications>=1, support_requests>=1, ...}}; old token -> 401; login with deleted creds -> 401; bill file endpoint returns 404 after deletion; admin cannot self-delete (403); unauthenticated delete -> 401. Referral integrity: when referrer A deletes account, referred user B still exists and B.referred_by is null. Frontend (390x844 web preview) verified: register screen shows register-legal + register-terms + register-privacy; register/login flow OK; all 9 profile items present (profile-card, profile-name, profile-notifications, profile-referral, profile-support, profile-privacy, profile-terms, profile-logout, profile-delete-account); /support screen shows support-email-address='assistenza@bolty.it', posting a valid subject/message shows support-sent with request_id sup_xxx; /delete-account: delete-confirm aria-disabled=true until delete-understood is ticked, tick+confirm dialog -> user logged out, lands on /login, login with deleted creds shows 'Credenziali non valide'; login-legal + login-google buttons visible; all main screens (Home, Forniture, Bollette, Offerte, Profilo, Notifiche, Referral, Market, Support) load without red screen or crash; Home renders home-market card with Luce/Gas prices as verified in iteration 4. CRITICAL BUG FOUND on the offer-accept -> contract flow: after submitting the contract at step 2 (contract-primary tap on filled data + accept-terms), the app crashes with React error boundary 'Element type is invalid... Check the render method of OfferDetail(./offer/[id].tsx)'. Backend correctly persists the contract (offer status becomes 'accettata', contract.status='in_lavorazione'), but the OfferDetail component crashes when re-rendering with the newly attached contract branch (line ~93-117 in /app/frontend/app/offer/[id].tsx renders <Badge> + <CheckCircle/Clock/Circle> icons + <H2>). This blocks the contract-done success screen from showing and leaves URL at /?id=off_XXXX with an error toast 'Element type is invalid: expected...'. Register-privacy popup: window.open (used by openLegal on web) was not detectable in the automated test (popup blocked in headless preview) — recommend main agent verify manually or via anchor with target=_blank fallback. Deprecated packages detected: none. Deprecated react-native prop warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (minor, non-blocking). SafeAreaView issues: none. React Native red screens: 1 (offer/contract flow — critical).

Blocks the contract-done success screen and leaves the user on /?id=off_XXX with an error boundary. Reference: /app/frontend/app/offer/[id].tsx:93-117

The customer sees an error toast instead of the success screen — regression for App Store build.

rca_of_issue: RCA of the OfferDetail crash: after `useMutation.onSuccess`, the code calls `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['offer', id] })` which forces OfferDetail (still mounted in the navigation stack) to re-render with the freshly-attached `offer.contract` object. This triggers the previously-unreached branch at offer/[id].tsx:93-117 which uses <Badge>, <H2>, <CheckCircle>, <Clock>, <Circle>, and `statusMeta`. The error 'Element type is invalid: ... got: undefined' means one of these named imports resolves to undefined at runtime — most likely `Circle` from phosphor-react-native (some phosphor versions expose it as `CircleIcon` or omit it), or a mismatch in the ui.tsx exports on the built bundle. Mitigation: (1) console.log each imported symbol at module top to find the undefined one; (2) as a quick workaround replace `<Circle />` with `<CheckCircle weight='regular' />` or use `require` to inspect the phosphor module; (3) once fixed, add a test that navigates offer -> contract -> submit and asserts [data-testid='contract-done'] is visible.
